description: This file defines the SalarySlip class and related functions for handling salary slip processing in an ERP system, including calculations, validations, and email notifications.

classes.name: SalarySlip
classes.description: Main class for handling salary slip creation, validation, calculation, and communication in the payroll system.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SalarySlip object.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Generates the name for the salary slip based on a series pattern.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks before processing the salary slip.

methods.name: set_net_total_in_words
methods.description: Converts total net pay into words for display.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the salary slip is submitted.

methods.name: update_payment_status_for_gratuity
methods.description: Updates the status of gratuity related to the salary slip.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the salary slip is canceled.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the salary slip is deleted.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the salary slip.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates the start and end dates of the salary slip against employee joining and relieving dates.

methods.name: is_rounding_total_disabled
methods.description: Checks if total rounding is disabled in payroll settings.

methods.name: check_existing
methods.description: Checks if a salary slip already exists for the employee and period.

methods.name: get_date_details
methods.description: Sets start and end dates for the salary slip if not already set.

methods.name: get_emp_and_working_day_details
methods.description: Loads employee and working day details, including leave and attendance.

methods.name: set_time_sheet
methods.description: Associates timesheets with the salary slip if based on timesheet.

methods.name: check_sal_struct
methods.description: Checks and assigns the relevant salary structure for the employee.

methods.name: pull_sal_struct
methods.description: Pulls salary structure details into the salary slip.

methods.name: get_working_days_details
methods.description: Calculates working days, leave without pay, and payment days.

methods.name: set_loan_repayment
methods.description: Calculates and sets loan repayment details.

methods.name: get_loan_details
methods.description: Retrieves active loans for the employee.

methods.name: make_loan_repayment_entry
methods.description: Creates and submits loan repayment entries.

methods.name: cancel_loan_repayment_entry
methods.description: Cancels existing loan repayment entries.

methods.name: email_salary_slip
methods.description: Sends the salary slip via email to the employee.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the document status.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the salary slip.

methods.name: process_salary_structure
methods.description: Recalculates salary based on structure and working days.

methods.name: pull_emp_details
methods.description: Pulls employee bank and payment details.

methods.name: process_salary_based_on_working_days
methods.description: Recalculates salary based on working days.

methods.name: set_totals
methods.description: Calculates gross, deductions, and net pay totals.

methods.name: set_base_totals
methods.description: Calculates base currency totals.

methods.name: calculate_total_for_salary_slip_based_on_timesheet
methods.description: Calculates total hours and wages for timesheet-based salary slips.

methods.name: compute_year_to_date
methods.description: Calculates year-to-date totals.

methods.name: compute_month_to_date
methods.description: Calculates month-to-date totals.

methods.name: compute_component_wise_year_to_date
methods.description: Calculates component-wise year-to-date totals.

methods.name: get_year_to_date_period
methods.description: Determines the period for year-to-date calculations.

methods.name: add_leave_balances
methods.description: Adds leave balance details to the salary slip.
